WITH counts_by_type AS (
  SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(*) AS execution_count
  FROM orderexecutions AS e
  JOIN orders AS o
    ON o.recordvault = e.ordersmark
  GROUP BY o.ordertune
), shares AS (
  SELECT ordertune,
         execution_count,
         1.0 * execution_count / SUM(execution_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM counts_by_type
), above_average AS (
  SELECT execution_count, share,
         AVG(share) OVER () AS overall_average_share
  FROM shares
)
SELECT SUM(execution_count) AS sum_of_counts,
       AVG(share) AS average_share,
       AVG(share - overall_average_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM above_average
WHERE share > overall_average_share;

assumptions.assumption: The total count for calculating shares includes only executions that match an order, as specified by dropping executions without a matching order.
